subject: Integrator Enablement Retreat — agenda and alignment
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@solvexconsulting.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Integrator Enablement Retreat — agenda and alignment

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for agreeing to run the joint integrator enablement retreat with SolveX on March 28. I wanted to share a first-pass agenda and align on logistics and goals before we lock anything in. High-level objectives:

- Accelerate SolvX pre-sales enablement for their solution architects and consultants
- Hands-on labs to validate a sample integration flow (auth, streaming, KVs)
- Co-selling play: account mapping and follow-up motions

Draft agenda (half-day):
1) 09:00–09:20 — Introductions & objectives (Redwood + SolveX)
2) 09:20–10:10 — Solution brief: Redwood serving runtime & recommended deployment patterns
3) 10:10–10:40 — Live lab: embedding + prompt-design workshop
4) 10:40–11:10 — Breakout: SI patterns & customer-fit discussions
5) 11:10–11:40 — Co-selling playbook and next steps
6) 11:40–12:00 — Action items & SOW/ops checklist

Attached: SI_Retreat_Agenda_v1.pdf (agenda + tech pre-reqs), redwood-solution-brief-2027.pptx (high level slides), partner-playbook-draft.docx (work-in-progress).

Can you confirm:
- Primary SolveX attendees (names + roles)
- Any additional hands-on lab requests or customer scenarios you want us to cover
- AV / network constraints (if you're in-person) or preferred videoconference provider

If this looks good I'll circulate a calendar invite and a short prep doc for the attendees.

Best,
Priyom
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Priyom — thanks, this looks great.

SolveX will send 10 people: 4 solutions architects, 3 delivery leads, 2 sales engineers, 1 partnerships lead (Tom K.). We love the hands-on lab idea — could we add a 30-minute deep dive on private deployment patterns and a short troubleshooting checklist for on-prem installs? A couple of our SAs will want to test multi-tenant isolation scenarios.

Also: can you share any co-sell case studies or one-pagers we can use on calls? We’d like to include them in our internal enablement pack next week.
